title: Robo-Soldier Startup Backed by Eric Trump Faces Collapse
excerpt: A robotics startup backed by Eric Trump has missed payroll a year after the CEO used company funds for a luxury home.
body_html: A robotics startup that received backing from Eric Trump has missed its payroll and is reportedly facing potential collapse. The financial trouble comes approximately one year after the company's chief executive officer used funds from the business to purchase a luxury home.
